title: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
abstract: arXiv:2608.00101v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex) interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of coding agents using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June-July 2026, comprising 7.4M users, 819M conversations, 5.7B LLM calls, and 946T tokens. Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with unique systems implications: e.g., sparse user-initiated turns unfold into autonomous agent loops with nearly 1:1 coupling between LLM calls and tool execution; parallel LLM calls are rare but exist in turns that trigger subagents; KV cache hit rates average 90% within a turn, but fall to 52% across turn boundaries and to 6% after model switches; workflows and user behaviors exhibit diverse, long-tailed resource footprints. translated_title: 真实环境中的智能体编程：生产规模下的GitHub Copilot追踪数据特征分析
translated_abstract: AI编码智能体（如GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Codex）将多步骤的LLM推理与工具执行交错进行，形成了一种有别于聊天机器人的新型工作负载。我们利用2026年6月至7月采样的GitHub Copilot追踪数据，首次对编码智能体进行了生产规模的表征分析，数据涵盖740万用户、8.19亿条对话、57亿次LLM调用以及946万亿token。我们的分析揭示了独特的工作负载特性及其对系统设计的特殊影响：例如，稀疏的用户发起轮次会展开为自主运行的智能体循环，LLM调用与工具执行之间呈现接近1:1的耦合关系；并行LLM调用较为罕见，但在触发子智能体的轮次中存在；KV缓存命中率在轮次内部平均可达90%，但在轮次边界处降至52%，在模型切换后更是降至6%；工作流和用户行为表现出多样化且呈长尾分布的资源占用特征。我们还进一步区分了较短的智能体响应时间与长达数分钟的用户空闲期……
tldr: 本文首次在生产规模上（740万用户、57亿次LLM调用）对GitHub Copilot编码智能体的追踪数据进行系统性分析，揭示了LLM调用与工具执行近乎1:1耦合、KV缓存命中率在轮次边界和模型切换时大幅下降、以及长尾资源占用分布等独特工作负载特性及其系统启示。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first production-scale characterization of AI coding agents using sampled GitHub Copilot traces (7.4M users, 819M conversations, 5.7B LLM calls), revealing distinctive workload properties such as near 1:1 coupling between LLM calls and tool execution, steep KV cache hit rate drops across turn boundaries and after model switches, and long-tailed resource footprints with unique systems implications.
